name: fix_ts_interface_optional
description: Fixes Partial-override merging that fails strict and loses defaults
prompts: config.ts fails `tsc --strict`: buildConfig assigns possibly-undefined Partial fields straight into the required RetryConfig fields. Fix config.ts so it compiles under --strict and unspecified overrides fall back to defaults: retries defaults to 3 and backoffMs to 100, while provided overrides (including explicit 0 values) win. Keep the exported names and signatures.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit config.ts 
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build config.ts
node behavior_test.js
